blockers.description: Reopen evidence: None of the three DoD artifacts exists in the repo or its history: `docs/operations/incident-response-flowchart.svg`, `docs/operations/deployment-checklist.md`, `artifacts/logs/rollback-test.log`. Only a generator script (`tools/scripts/generate-rollback-test-log.ts`) exists. KPI "All procedures tested" has no evidence.

To close: (1) Produce the three artifacts. The rollback log must come from a real rollback (e.g. a Railway redeploy of the previous image), not from the generator. Closing requires production evidence (configured endpoint, real trace ID, received alert); local, in-memory or template artifacts do not count.

Re-plan 2026-10-16 (owner ruling "Fix the 15 tasks"): not Completed, no exemption. Stays in its sprint, which is not gated yet. incident-response-flowchart.svg, deployment-checklist.md and a rollback-test.log from a real rollback do not exist. Verified 2026-10-16: Railway production api and ai-worker have OTEL_ENABLED=true and export to the Grafana Cloud gb-south-1 gateway; ws, events-worker and ingestion-worker do not (events-worker and ingestion-worker OTEL_ENABLED=false, ws has no OTel variables). Grafana holds span metrics for api and ai-worker and ai-worker pino log lines carrying trace_id/span_id; no api pino log line has reached Loki yet.
